titulo_original: La Pena No Duerme de Noche

sinopsis.es: Un hombre se aísla en el bosque con su gato. Los fantasmas de su pasado empiezan a atormentarlo y lo obligan a enfrentar sus miedos y sus culpas para no dejarse consumir por la locura.
sinopsis.en: A man secludes himself in the forest with his cat. The ghosts of his past begin to torment him, being forced to face his fears and guilts in a try to not be consumed by madness.
